name: Starters
description: Kick off your feast with a tempting selection of crispy, grilled, and bite-sized starters packed with bold flavors.

name: Chaat Counter
description: A burst of Indian street flavors featuring tangy, spicy, and crunchy chaats prepared fresh for an irresistible experience.

name: Soup
description: Warm, comforting bowls of freshly prepared soups that set the perfect tone for a wholesome meal.

name: Fruit Counter
description: A refreshing spread of fresh-cut seasonal fruits, ideal for a light, healthy, and refreshing indulgence.

name: Mocktail Counter
description: Colorful and refreshing non-alcoholic mocktails blended with fresh fruits, herbs, and fizz to elevate your celebration.

name: Juice & Shakes
description: A delightful range of freshly squeezed juices and creamy shakes made with premium fruits and ingredients.

name: Main Course
description: A lavish spread of rich gravies, classic preparations, and hearty dishes crafted to be the highlight of your meal.

name: Rice & Biryani
description: Aromatic rice dishes and flavorful biryanis cooked with fragrant spices for a satisfying and indulgent experience.

name: Dal & Curries
description: Comforting dals and richly spiced curries slow-cooked to perfection, offering authentic and homely flavors.

name: Breads
description: An assortment of soft, fluffy, and oven-fresh Indian breads that perfectly complement every curry.

name: South Indian
description: Traditional South Indian delicacies featuring dosas, idlis, uttapams, and aromatic accompaniments.

name: Italian
description: Classic Italian favorites including pastas, sauces, and baked dishes infused with rich herbs and cheeses.

name: Live Counters
description: Interactive live food stations where dishes are freshly prepared on the spot for a personalized dining experience.

name: Pan Asian
description: A fusion of Asian flavors featuring wok-tossed dishes, sauces, and spices inspired by the Far East.

name: Mangolian
description: Flavor-packed Mongolian-style dishes prepared with fresh vegetables, sauces, and live stir-fry techniques.

name: Chinese
description: Popular Indo-Chinese and authentic Chinese dishes offering the perfect balance of spice, crunch, and flavor.

name: Burmese
description: Authentic Burmese-inspired dishes showcasing subtle spices, fresh ingredients, and comforting flavors.

name: Coffee Bar
description: A premium coffee station serving freshly brewed coffees, cappuccinos, and specialty blends.

name: Sweets
description: Traditional Indian sweets prepared with authentic recipes, rich ingredients, and timeless flavors.

name: Desserts
description: A tempting collection of modern and classic desserts designed to add a sweet ending to your meal.

name: Paan Counter
description: A traditional paan counter offering a variety of refreshing and flavorful paans for the perfect after-meal experience.
